parsed.note_claim: Congress explicitly granted the executive branch the authority to designate, extend, or terminate Temporary Protected Status (TPS).
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: The Attorney General , after consultation with appropriate agencies of the Government, may designate any foreign state (or any part of such foreign state) under this subsection
parsed.reason: The text confirms the Attorney General (executive branch) has statutory authority to designate, terminate, and extend TPS.
